title: Explaining why a proposed practice is wrong, with a worked pair
code_snippet:
User: "Our CI runs `govulncheck -json ./... && echo ok`. A teammate says
that's wrong but can't explain why. Walk me through it."
expected_feedback: This is an S7 anti-pattern (AE-3), so load references/anti-examples.md and answer with the WRONG/RIGHT pair rather than paraphrasing. The rule table in SKILL.md S7 is binding on its own — govulncheck exits 0 under -json whatever it found — but the worked pair is what makes the fix copy-pasteable: gate on the text-mode exit code, or parse findings from JSON with jq -s.
coverage_rules: Gate on the text-mode exit code
